extracted.description: Forecast target must be Swarm Alpha's along-track acceleration 3 hours ahead, evaluated during May 11, 2024.

stored.description: Forecast target must be Swarm Alpha's along-track acceleration 3 hours ahead, evaluated during May 11, 2024.
acceptanceCriteria: Target variable is the along-track acceleration of the Swarm Alpha satellite
Forecast horizon is 3 hours ahead (inputs at time t predict the target at t+3h)
Forecast/evaluation period is restricted to May 11, 2024

assertions.description: Forecast target must be Swarm Alpha's along-track acceleration 3 hours ahead, evaluated during May 11, 2024.

stored.description: Model inputs must come from the specified sources only: OMNI Kp index and OMNI solar wind dynamic pressure (Pdyn), predicting Swarm Alpha along-track acceleration.
acceptanceCriteria: Model 1 uses only the OMNI Kp index as its single input feature
Model 2 uses only the OMNI solar wind dynamic pressure (Pdyn) as its single input feature
No additional predictors are used in either model; the target observations are Swarm Alpha along-track acceleration

assertions.description: Model inputs must come from the specified sources only: OMNI Kp index and OMNI solar wind dynamic pressure (Pdyn), predicting Swarm Alpha along-track acceleration.

stored.description: Predictive accuracy of both models must be quantified using RMSE against observed along-track acceleration.
acceptanceCriteria: RMSE is the error metric used for both models
RMSE is computed against observed along-track acceleration values over the same evaluation window for both models

assertions.description: Predictive accuracy of both models must be quantified using RMSE against observed along-track acceleration.

stored.description: Both RMSE values must be produced by single-variable linear regression models evaluated on a held-out test set.
acceptanceCriteria: Each model is a single-variable linear regression as specified
Each model has a train/test split with a distinct test set
Reported RMSE values correspond to test-set predictions, not training-set fit

assertions.description: Both RMSE values must be produced by single-variable linear regression models evaluated on a held-out test set.

stored.description: Compare the predictive accuracy of the two models to determine which input (Kp vs Pdyn) yields better 3-hour-ahead forecast accuracy.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly two models are compared under identical target, forecast horizon, date window, and evaluation protocol
The comparison outcome identifies which model achieves the lower test-set RMSE

assertions.description: Compare the predictive accuracy of the two models to determine which input (Kp vs Pdyn) yields better 3-hour-ahead forecast accuracy.
